notes: Expanded local dataset for a London startup map. Company selection is based on startupmap.london visible/listed companies, Parallel research snippets captured on 2026-05-05, official websites where available, and the saved Concept Ventures portfolio list. Locations are explicitly labelled by precision: exact public office/HQ, registered office, sourced area, or area estimate.
